verdict: FAIL — STOPPED AT PHASE A (imitation gate)
gate_failed: Phase A: >= 99.5% held-out teacher-forced victim agreement for every (controller, held-out seed)
posthoc_summary: At held-out errors the network's choice has the same planted local state as the teacher victim (LRU/LFU/TWOQ 100%, SIEVE 84-98%) but is newer (LFU/TWOQ median dt 1-40 vs teacher 7-61): the class order is learned but the within-class oldest-first recency tie-break is not. LFU/TWOQ learned the shortcut 'evict the newest insertion', which is correct whenever only one count-0/probationary item is resident. LRU training agreement was still rising at pass 20 (CE 1.7). TWOQ/SIEVE fail 72-97% of burst-segment evictions. No neural choice at an error had dt beyond the training range, so dt extrapolation is not the cause.
authorization_note: No retuning, no rescue, no OMD-1. Methodological pilot only; no novelty claim.
